llmfill 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Enables AI-powered automated form/questionnaire/worksheet filling in Word (.docx) files using LLMFill remote service.
- Supports knowledge base creation and management, allowing users to upload reference materials for improved answer accuracy.
- Provides commands for checking API token balance/validity and discovering available service interfaces.
- Offers both CLI (Python, curl) operation, with guided first-time setup and API token generation.
- Core features include asynchronous fill (auto polling), dual-version (marked/clean) result downloads, and task progress reporting.
- Full error code explanations and troubleshooting guidance included.
